create_multi_task_trainer: create a MultiTaskTrainer instance with a model, task list, optimizer params, and lr scheduler params
build_multi_task_trainer_from_params: build a MultiTaskTrainer from a Params object using the from_params class method
save_model_checkpoint: save the model, optimizer, scheduler, and metric states to the serialization directory
restore_model_checkpoint: restore the model, optimizer, scheduler, and metric states from the latest checkpoint
find_latest_checkpoint: find the latest model and training state checkpoint files in the serialization directory
